# Wood tower shield

Internal ID: ShieldWoodTower | Type: Shield | Source: Workbench | Usage: Blocking | Wielding: Off-hand | Crafting Materials: Wood x10, Leather scraps x6 | Movement speed: -10%

# Introduction

The Wood tower shield is the first tower shield. It has four more block armor and 80 more block force compared to Wood shield but reduces movement speed by 10% as well as increasing dodge roll cost by 10%.
As a tower shield, it cannot be used to parry enemy attacks.

## Upgrade information

Cost to max is 25 wood and 15 leather scraps.

• stat: Block armor | Quality 1: 10 | Quality 2: 16 | Quality 3: 22

• stat: Durability | Quality 1: 200 | Quality 2: 250 | Quality 3: 300

• stat: Crafting | Quality 1: 10 Wood6 Leather scraps | Quality 2: 5 Wood3 Leather scraps | Quality 3: 10 Wood6 Leather scraps

• stat: Workbench level | Quality 1: 1 | Quality 2: 2 | Quality 3: 3

## Notes

• When crafting, players can customize the shield with a few different pre-set designs and colors by clicking the style button beneath the item name in the crafting window. The design can not be changed afterward.
